description: Owner-stated release commitments and target dates. Authoritative and hand-editable. This is intent, not observed fact, which is why it lives beside current/index.json rather than inside it.
notes: targetDate is the resolved calendar date. statedAs preserves the owner's original wording so a re-read can catch a misinterpretation.
precision records how firm the date is: 'day' was given explicitly, 'week' and 'month' were rounded from relative phrasing, 'none' means no date was given.
Set status to 'done' when shipped, or 'slipped' with a new targetDate. Do not delete a commitment that slipped - the history is the point.

The Apple/D&B critical-path item is deliberately NOT a commitment. It is a blocker, carried as gap apple-org-enrollment-dnb and referenced from the commitments it gates, so it appears once rather than twice.

Three App Store releases are ordered rather than dated: real timing depends on Apple review approval and Carol's sign-off, so queuePosition is the commitment and targetDate stays null. A null targetDate with a queuePosition is deliberate, not missing data.

2026-08-30: rebuilt against origin/main. AmenBeats marked done (submitted for review 2026-08-27). KinFlash split into Family and Studio commitments to match the two entities created 2026-08-30. Apple/D&B blockers repointed to gap apple-developer-org-conversion, which supersedes the earlier owner-stated record with Apple case 20000146677819.
